question: Which of the following policies involves integrating the domestic economy with the global economy?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Globalisation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Globalisation** refers to the process of integrating the **domestic economy with the global economy**.
 
• It involves increasing **international trade** and **investment** flows.
 
• Globalisation facilitates the **movement of goods, services, capital, technology, and labor** across borders.
 
• It aims to create a more **interconnected and interdependent world** economy.
 
• This process is driven by advancements in **communication and transportation technologies**.
 
• Globalisation can lead to increased **economic growth, innovation, and cultural exchange**.
 
• However, it may also result in **economic disparities** and **cultural homogenisation**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Privatisation**__

 __
 
• **Privatisation** refers to the transfer of ownership of **state-owned enterprises** to the **private sector**.
 
• It aims to increase **efficiency, productivity, and competition** in the market.
 
• Examples include the privatisation of **telecommunication, airlines, and energy sectors** in many countries.
 
 
 
• **Liberalisation**__
 __
 
• **Liberalisation** involves the **removal of government restrictions** on economic activities.
 
• It encourages **free-market policies** and aims to promote **economic growth and development**.
 
• Examples include the reduction of **tariffs, quotas, and deregulation** in various industries.
 
 
 
• **Capitalist Economy**__
 
 
• A **capitalist economy** is an economic system where **private individuals or businesses** own and operate the means of production.
 
• It is characterized by **free markets, competition, and profit motive**.
 
• Examples include the economies of the **United States, Canada, and Germany**.
